pose_npz.time_seconds: N float64 audio received position; may repeat; not a frame clock
pose_npz.wall_time_seconds: N float64 strictly increasing perf_counter seconds relative to stream start plus startup silence
pose_npz.audio_received_sample_index: N int64 audio receive position, excluding startup silence
pose_npz.wall_clock_origin_perf_counter: scalar float64; process-local monotonic origin, not UTC
pose_npz.final_qpos: N by model_nq float64, final displayed MuJoCo qpos
pose_npz.joint_positions: N by J float32 final qpos at joint_qpos_indices
pose_npz.model_xml_sha256: top-level model XML SHA-256; dependency asset hashes in cohort manifest
pose_npz.safety_counts: N by 4: candidate_clearance_detection, collision_projection, final_residual_clearance, final_joint_limit
pose_npz.beat_events: B by 4: event_wall_seconds, delivery_wall_seconds, audio_received_seconds, accepted; all detector beats, not only controller-accepted beats
pose_npz.accepted_causal_beat_times_seconds: legacy controller-accepted audio positions retained for compatibility; use beat_events for new causal BAS

evaluation: discard first 6 audio-origin wall seconds; output frames at actual wall clocks; BAS uses delivery times on 60 FPS resampled motion
safety_semantics: Configured clearance pairs and existing minimum distance plus buffer; kinematic only; audit overhead included in control work
readiness: Integrity-complete does not imply performance or safety passed
